extracted.name: Peanut simple cake
extracted.description: Just a simple cake for breakfast, coffee break or any gatherings. It's delicious!
ingredient_lines: 1 cup grated toasted peanut (or peanut butter, sugarless)
instruction_lines: Mix the flour with baking powder and the peanut and set aside.
In a blender, mix the rest of the ingredients until smooth (if you're using peanut butter, put it here instead of in the flour mix)
Mix dry ingredients with the liquid ones and pour over a greased cooking pan.
Cook in oven pre heated at 200°C for about 35/50min.
